sources.supports: The Shell32 function takes a known-folder GUID reference, DWORD flags, optional HANDLE and PWSTR output pointer. NULL token addresses the current user. Returned allocation must be released using CoTaskMemFree even on failure. S_OK is successful.

Flags zero have no special options. Omitting DEFAULT_PATH selects the current possibly redirected folder. Omitting CREATE avoids folder creation. With DONT_VERIFY unset, a missing or inaccessible folder may produce failure.
Pictures has GUID 33E28130-4E1E-4676-835A-98395C3BC3BB. PicturesLibrary is a different known folder; it is not the physical Pictures directory.
New native code should query known-folder IDs rather than legacy CSIDL. COM must already be initialized on the thread that calls SHGetKnownFolderPath.

S_OK and S_FALSE successful initialization calls must each be balanced with CoUninitialize. RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE means an existing incompatible apartment or a neutral-apartment transition; that unsuccessful initialization must not be balanced by this caller.
CoTaskMemFree releases an allocation of the COM task allocator; NULL is a no-op. The returned string cannot be used after release.

mapping.testedProcess: Windows 11 amd64, pointer 8 bytes, WCHAR 2 bytes

apartmentBoundary: The resolver asks for MTA. S_OK/S_FALSE owns exactly one balanced initialization reference. When an existing STA rejects the MTA request with RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE, the synchronous Shell query uses the already initialized thread and never uninitializes that caller-owned STA. The real OS fixture proved this on this machine; no COM interface pointer is stored or transferred between threads.
notes: Flags0 semantics preserve redirection by API contract. The tested machine currently returns the ordinary current Pictures path; a real OneDrive/network redirection configuration was not changed or separately tested.
